name: Field notes
context: Field research, outdoor services, environmental observations
layout: Map or field image beside an observation log; group entries by place and time instead of identical cards.
typography: Humanist sans for controls; sturdy serif for narrative headings; tabular numerals for measurements.
signature: A location marker and time-stamped observation rail connected to real data.
avoid: Decorative map grids without geographic meaning.

name: Signal desk
layout: Compact status rail, large active workspace, and a persistent event list; group by urgency and time.
typography: Neutral sans for navigation; monospace only for identifiers, code, and numeric readouts.
signature: A live event timeline with clear severity labels and inspectable details.
avoid: Neon glows, fake terminal text, and decorative charts.

name: Culture poster
layout: Expressive typographic masthead paired with a real program or venue image; a readable schedule anchors the page.
typography: Condensed display for event identity with an open, legible sans for dates and booking controls.
signature: Oversized event typography tied to actual dates and venue information.
avoid: Unreadable text overlap and invented sponsor logos.

name: Workshop
layout: Strong horizontal bands, aligned specifications, and a task-oriented workbench with explicit units.
typography: Sturdy grotesk headings and readable sans body; tabular numerals for quantities.
signature: A specification rail or annotated equipment image that helps a real decision.
avoid: Warning stripes as decoration and tiny technical labels.

name: Gallery
layout: Image-led sequence with deliberate changes in image scale, clear captions, and quiet navigation.
typography: One restrained sans family with strong size contrast; captions remain readable at small viewports.
signature: A project image sequence whose crops and pacing tell the work's story.
avoid: Huge empty spaces when no useful imagery exists.

name: Public service
layout: Task-first heading, bounded form width, clear progress, and a contextual help rail; prioritize comprehension.
typography: Accessible system sans with generous line height; clear text labels and a modest heading scale.
signature: A plain-language checklist showing what users need before starting.
avoid: Showy animation, vague CTA copy, and hiding eligibility requirements.

name: Precision
context: Premium products, focused software, and considered product storytelling
layout: A clear product focal point, concise benefit narrative, and purposeful changes in scale; use real detail views instead of repeated feature cards.
typography: System sans or an existing brand family; carefully balanced display weight, readable body measure, and tabular data. Tighten display tracking only where legibility permits.
signature: An inspectable product detail or working interaction that demonstrates a real benefit.
avoid: Imitating Apple branding, fake product renders, empty superlatives, glass on every surface, and scroll-jacking.
